auth0-nextjs-auth0-mfa.description: Multi-factor authentication with @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4: redirect step-up via Universal Login (amr gating), server-side step-up on mfa_required, the MFA management API (getAuthenticators, enroll, challenge, verify), and reactive step-up via mfa.challengeWithPopup(). Covers the beforeSessionSaved amr hook, the secure mfa_token handoff, and MFA error classes.

auth0-nextjs-auth0-root.description: Add authentication to Next.js applications using @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4 (App Router + Pages Router): install, Auth0Client singleton, middleware/proxy route mounting, env config, useUser, getSession/getAccessToken, protecting pages and API routes, and step-up MFA. Entry point for all nextjs-auth0 skills.

auth0-nextjs-auth0-organizations.description: Auth0 Organizations (multi-tenant B2B) with @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4: pass organization at login via authorizationParameters / the /auth/login query param / startInteractiveLogin, read org_id back from the session, validate it on the backend, accept invitations, and configure orgs/connections via the Auth0 CLI or Terraform.

auth0-nextjs-auth0-passkeys.description: Passkey (WebAuthn) flows with @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4: signup, sign-in, and My Account enrollment using the server-side auth0.passkey.* API inside App Router route handlers or server actions, with navigator.credentials and serializeCredential in the browser.
